state.context: hoandat.com ecosystem, one operator. Owner decided 13/11/2026: account deletion happens only at the IdP (auth.hoandat.com/account), immediately, every app erases the account's data when the IdP's signed account.deleted notice arrives; the IdP retries until the app answers 2xx. Web Nhanh hosts user websites at <name>.hoandat.io.vn. When an owner deletes one website themselves, Web Nhanh refuses while the site is taken down by an admin (abuse) or the account is locked, to keep evidence for the admin. For IdP-driven account deletion the new receiver deletes every site of the account immediately, including taken-down ones; abuse_reports and admin_actions rows stay (site/account ids set to null, site name kept), but the release files of a taken-down site are removed. Today there are no outside users yet (only the owner); no abuse cases exist on prod.

options.delete_all_now: Keep as built: every site goes immediately, including taken-down ones; reports and admin log rows stay as text evidence. One rule for every app, no special queue.
options.hold_taken_down: Delete everything else immediately, but leave sites under admin takedown (and their files) until the admin closes the case, then remove them; the IdP still gets 202. Needs an extra state and a cleanup path for held sites.

takedown.instructions: Which behaviour should Web Nhanh use for sites under admin takedown when their owner's account is deleted at the IdP? Weigh: simplicity and one rule across apps (the owner's stated goal is fewer special cases); keeping evidence of abuse when it matters; privacy (erase the deleted person's data); current scale (no outside users, no abuse cases yet).
